usage: The word '霧' (mou6) is used as a noun to describe fog or mist in the atmosphere.
It commonly appears in weather descriptions to indicate low visibility conditions caused by fog.
You can use '霧' with verbs like '有' (jau5, to have) or '起' (hei2, to rise) when talking about fog appearing or existing.
'霧' can also be combined with other weather terms to describe specific types of fog, such as '濃霧' (nung4 mou6, thick fog).
